Overview.Name: Sandhya
Overview.Goal: Support hormonal balance, mental wellbeing, and steady fat loss.

Early_Morning: Option 1: Warm water + plain milk (small cup)
Option 2: Warm water + small bowl curd
Meal_1_Breakfast: Option 1: Paneer bhurji (pan fried) + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Curd bowl + cooked vegetable side
Option 3: Rice rawa upma (small portion) with vegetables
Meal_2_Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (small portion) + dal + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Plain rice (small portion) + paneer curry + vegetables
Option 3: Plain rice (small portion) + curd + vegetable curry
Meal_3_Dinner: Option 1: Paneer curry + small portion plain rice + vegetables
Option 2: Dal + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables
Option 3: Vegetable curry + small portion plain rice + curd

Notes_and_Tips: Keep meals regular to support thyroid and PCOS management.
Fried foods trigger cravings; keep them occasional.
For stress or boredom eating, pause and eat slowly.
Field work increases activity; do not skip meals.
Small rice portions at dinner help digestion and sleep.
Consistency with yoga and meals supports mental wellbeing.
